changeSet.author: skill-probe
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO shopitems (shopid, itemid, price, pitch, position) SELECT s.shopid, r.itemid, r.price, 0, 200 + r.slot FROM (SELECT 1011100 AS shopid UNION ALL SELECT 1021100 UNION ALL SELECT 1031100 UNION ALL SELECT 1051002 UNION ALL SELECT 1091002) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT 4006000 AS itemid, 800 AS price, 0 AS slot UNION ALL SELECT 4006001, 800, 1) r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shopitems i WHERE i.shopid = s.shopid AND i.itemid = r.itemid);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM shopitems WHERE itemid IN (4006000, 4006001) AND shopid IN (1011100, 1021100, 1031100, 1051002, 1091002) AND position IN (200, 201);
